parts.name: nut_plate
parts.desc: Laser-cut 6061 nut plate under the carrier's square. How the bed is lifted (v12.1): the POM anti-backlash nut z_nut (supplied on the motor's screw; StepperOnline drawing A4003: 26 mm square flange, 4-M4 on an 18.5 mm square) rides lead screw leadscrew. Its flange is bolted to the underside of this 9.525 mm plate by two M3 x 20 through-bolts in the flange's two outer holes (washers and thread-locked nuts on the plate's top face); the plate is bolted under the 2020 square's member sq_rear (two M5 from below into T-nuts) and reaches 56.2 mm out to the screw. The nut is fixed: the screw, held only by its motor and free at its top end, bends slightly to follow any misalignment (as on a Voron Trident). The screw passes a 9 mm hole open to the plate's outer edge, so the plate slides onto a screw whose motor already stands.

findings.message: nut_plate: 4 hole(s) or cut-out(s) narrower than the 9.525 mm sheet (smallest 4.80 mm at [-13.08, 201.6, 140.42]): they cut, but taper and lose accuracy.
findings.hint: Make them at least 9.525 mm, or drill or ream them after cutting if the size matters.

findings.message: nut_plate: 4 hole(s) with less than 9.525 mm of material to the edge (least 5.00 mm at [-20.0, 135.4, 140.42]): the web overheats and distorts, and tears if the part is bent or loaded.
findings.hint: Move the hole in, or widen the part there, to leave at least 9.525 mm.

findings.message: nut_plate: 1 slot(s) or notch(es) in the outline narrower than 9.525 mm (narrowest about 9.00 mm at [0.0, 208.38, 140.42]): the cut is ragged and the slot closes up with heat.
findings.hint: Widen to at least 9.525 mm.

findings.message: nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_min_al6061_page: smallest hole or cut-out 4.8 mm (4 of 4), limit >= 9.53 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Design holes no smaller than material thickness.").

nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_al6061_page: hole edge to part edge 5 mm (4 of 4), limit >= 14.3 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Keep holes and cutouts 1.5–2× material thickness away from edges to prevent warping or distortion.").

nut_plate: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_d_ratio: hole edge to part edge 5 mm (2 of 4), limit >= 5.5 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.").

nut_plate: 2 outside corner(s) of the cut profile are dead sharp (no radius). A sheet part with needle corners cuts hands and cables and chips its paint; a corner radius costs nothing in laser or waterjet cutting.
findings.hint: Round every outside corner to at least 0.5 mm (1 to 3 mm on corners a hand meets).
